speaker: narrator
text: Part eight. The storm's over. But Bit *won't wake*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay presses it again. And *again*.

speaker: hero
text: You said one day. Maybe *two*.

speaker: narrator
text: Ezra knocks. He holds up a *battery*. It's dead.

speaker: narrator
text: Every battery in town is *dead*.

speaker: narrator
text: Then Milo walks in. With a *solar panel*.

speaker: kid
text: It runs on the Sun. Is that *funny*?

speaker: narrator
text: The Sun broke Bit. Can the Sun *fix* him?

speaker: narrator
text: One hour. Two. Then a *beep*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay? Did you *look up*?

speaker: hero
text: Bit! I looked up. I used a *map*!

speaker: hero
text: And I sent Morse code. On a *storm*.

speaker: bit
text: Without me? I'm *proud*. And a bit jealous.

speaker: bit
text: Fun fact. In 2012, one *missed* us.

speaker: bit
text: By about *nine days*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit. Teach me *everything*. Just in case.

speaker: bit
text: Lesson one. *Unplug the dock*.

speaker: narrator
text: That night, the whole town *looks up*.

speaker: narrator
text: No storm. Just stars. And one robot *beeping*.

speaker: kid
text: Bit's doing Morse! It says... *T-H-A-N-K-S*.

speaker: narrator
text: Follow for a new What if every day.
